label: Promo signal — card carousel pick
description: Carousel-ad content slide (promo-signal skeleton: accent chip + headline + how-to) whose bottom art is a row of 2-4 labelled folder cards that slide horizontally while the highlight cycles card to card, like picking one. Card shape is a baked image; labels are parametric HTML. Extends the promo-* family (1080x1920) with the --brand-accent token.
